requirements.req: Category model with id, name (unique), description, reorder_threshold (optional int)
Product model with id, sku (unique), name, category_id (FK), price_cents (int), stock_qty (int), low_active (optional bool, default False)
CategoryRepository with CRUD + find all products belonging to a category
ProductRepository with CRUD + find products by category + find low-stock products + aggregate total stock value by category
InventoryService with add_product(sku, name, category_id, price_cents, stock_qty): validates the category exists and the sku is unique, then adds the product
InventoryService with update_product(id, data): updates a product's fields
InventoryService with delete_product(id): deletes a product by ID
InventoryService with get_product_by_id(id): returns a single product by its ID

InventoryService with list_products(category_id (Optional[int]), low_only (Optional[bool])): lists products filtered by optional category and optionally only low-stock ones; no filters returns all products
InventoryService with restock(id, qty): increases a product's stock_qty
InventoryService with low_stock_report(): returns products whose stock_qty is below their category's reorder_threshold
InventoryService with stock_value_by_category(): returns the total price_cents * stock_qty per category
CLI interface with nested command groups including product add, list, update, delete, restock, report low-stock, report value, category add, list, update, delete
All monetary values stored as integers (cents)
All IDs must be auto-incremented primary keys that are optional (default None) in the domain models
Implement proper error handling with custom exception classes: CategoryNotFoundError, ProductNotFoundError
Use SQLite with foreign keys enabled
